_comment: Pinned fixed WebView2 runtime (x64) for the offline portable build. The 'version' + 'sha256' fields are kept fresh by .github/workflows/webview2-sync.yml, which opens a PR whenever Microsoft publishes a new Edge/WebView2 Stable version. 'sha256' is the real SHA-256 of the vendored CAB below and IS verified by release.yml / verify-wv2-dl.yml. The CAB itself is vendored into the repo under vendor/ and tracked by Git LFS (see .gitattributes) because the old hosting host 'msedgedl.blob.core.windows.net' no longer resolves (verified 2026-08-13 in CI + sandbox). 'localPath' points to the vendored file (used by release.yml; falls back to downloadUrl only if the vendored file is absent). 'sourceUrl' is the current Microsoft delivery CDN URL for this exact build (per-version GUID, not template-able) — use it to refresh the vendored CAB when bumping the version. 'downloadUrl'/'downloadUrlTemplate' are retained only as legacy/fallback references and currently point at the dead host.
